email.subject: Harbor Pros Auto Care: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I looked at Harbor Pros Auto Care's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors (most of your traffic) have to manually dial instead of tapping to call, and the site isn't mobile-friendly, so it's hard to use on a phone at all. Between those two, you're probably losing customers who just give up and call a competitor instead.

I also noticed the footer looks outdated and hours aren't listed anywhere, which adds to the doubt.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
